subject: [PATCH v2 13/17] selftests/mm: verify synchronous khugepaged driving is attributable

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test to verify that synchronous khugepaged driving is attributable and deterministic. The test uses the huge_memory tracepoints to attribute outcomes and checks that exactly one collapse attempt is made on each prepared window, resulting in the window being collapsed afterwards. The test also sets scan_sleep_millisecs to 60s to prove the wake path. The patch adds a new selftest called khugepaged_sync_check and modifies several files to support it.
